endpoints.description: Analyze full earnings report and extract revenue, EPS, margins, segment performance, and investment signals

Analyze management tone, confidence signals, hedging language, topics avoided, and red flags

Validate earnings text readiness and recommend best analysis endpoint
ONE-CALL: full earnings analysis — metrics, beats/misses, guidance, sentiment, and investment signal
